content:
Ari (product): Quick check 1 layout + copy nits on Compliance row: retention text wraps, region placeholder emptiness, KMS badge labeling, and export CTA ambiguity. Can we sanity-check?
Kyla (design): Saw it. Suggest single-line retention and "All regions" fallback. Make Redwood-managed subtle and BYOK a filled pill.
Ben (eng): Backend supports `format=csv|json`. Setting CSV by default client-side is trivial. Reordering DOM to match LTR focus is also easy.
Marta (a11y): Focus order must match visual order. Tooltip for BYOK needs keyboard focus and aria-describedby. Add live region announcing "Export starting (CSV)".
Tom (legal): Keep copy conservative. Proposed retention: "Data retained for 30 days. Learn more." Export label: "Export filtered logs (CSV)". Avoid implying editable retention.
Kyla (design): I'll update mocks: retention single-line, region shows "All regions" when unset, badge labels: "Redwood-managed key" / "Customer-managed key (BYOK)".
Ari (product): Great. @Ben ping back with PR link and @Marta please run quick SR checks after.
ui-bot: Figma updated: https://www.figma.com/file/example/compliance (view)
